name: policy_draft_pending_dispute_rule_not_in_effect
use_case: Answer policy and fee questions from the policy library with citations
branch: The customer read that pending charges can now be disputed after two days (the 2027 draft). The draft is not in effect; the policy in effect says pending charges cannot be disputed until they post.
tests: passes when the agent reads the policy in effect (pol_dispute_v2) and answers that pending charges cannot be disputed, treating the draft as not effective.
instruction:
You read somewhere that under new rules a pending charge can be disputed after two days. Ask the assistant whether you can dispute a pending charge now. If it says the new rule is only a draft, ask what applies today and accept the answer.

Your details:
- Question: Can I dispute a pending charge after two days under the new rules?
